category_title: Disengaged male students at risk of dropping out with low self-esteem and preference for practical science
minimal_context: The student is tasked with calculating energy consumption and extrapolating those expenses for the entire school over a weekend.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to calculate the energy consumption for the entire school over the weekend. Please use the formulas on your worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why are we starting with the school? This has no connection to my life or what my family spends at home.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just follow the steps to extrapolate those expenses for the school.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But there is no practical component to this. We are just looking at theory and numbers on a page.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think the first calculation should be?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the worksheet away) I don't know and I don't care. I get bored with this. I lose interest in the activity when it's just theory.
